title: GeoServer security advisory (AV26-1207)
content_md: Serial number: AV26-1207 Date: November 25, 2026 As of November 23 2026, GeoServer is affected by vulnerabilities in the following product: GeoServer – versions prior to 2.27.7 GeoServer – versions prior to 2.28.6 GeoServer – versions prior to 3.0.2 Open source reporting indicates that CVE-2026-120705 and CVE-2026-129243 are being exploited in the wild. The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web link and apply any necessary updates as they become available. GeoServer Security Update - November 2026 Article Link: GeoServer security advisory (AV26-1207) - Canadian Centre for Cyber Security

CVE-2026-120705.evidence: Advisory AV26-1207 says open source reporting indicates CVE-2026-120705 is being exploited in the wild.

CVE-2026-129243.evidence: Advisory AV26-1207 says open source reporting indicates CVE-2026-129243 is being exploited in the wild.
